english.title: Vehicle - trade licence holder fail to show registration mark on trade plate
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a trade licence, used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), displaying a trade plate which failed to show the general registration mark assigned to you in respect of that licence
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 7 of Schedule 6 to the Road Vehicles (Registration and Licensing) Regulations 2002 and section 59(1) and (2)(b) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.
